userManagement.title: Users
userManagement.confirmEmail: Type the account email to confirm
userManagement.deleteWarning: This permanently deletes the Auth account and its profile. Museum content is retained. Owned Storage assets must be resolved separately; they are never deleted here.
userManagement.inviteHint: An Auth invitation creates the account. The recipient chooses a password through the invitation link. Email delivery is not verified here.
userManagement.inviteAccepted: Auth accepted the invitation and the profile was saved. Email delivery has not been verified.
userManagement.cancelled: The request was cancelled before it began. You can submit a new request.
userManagement.pending: An operation has an unconfirmed outcome. Check its result before submitting another change. The receipt is retained for this signed-in account.
userManagement.pendingDialog: Close this editor and use Check result to reconcile the operation. Do not submit it again.
userManagement.guardNotice: Role changes and privileged invitations are disabled until database concurrency guards are verified and enabled on the server.
userManagement.writesNotice: Account changes are disabled on the server.

errors.unauthorized: Your session is missing or expired. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Your current account is not authorized to manage users.
errors.selfProtected: You cannot delete your own account or change your own administrator role.
errors.lastAdmin: The last active administrator must be retained.
errors.conflict: This profile changed. Your edits are retained. Discard them and reload the current profile before saving again.
errors.duplicateAccount: An account already exists for this email. It has not been overwritten.
errors.assetsOwned: This account owns Storage assets. Resolve ownership separately before deletion.
errors.operationBusy: Another operation is pending, or the invitation limit was reached. Check existing results before retrying.
errors.operationUncertain: The outcome is not confirmed. Check the operation result; do not repeat the request.
errors.requestFailed: The operation was rejected. Review the account and try again if appropriate.
errors.serviceUnavailable: User management is unavailable. Check the Edge Function deployment and your connection, then reload.
errors.guardUnverified: Role and deletion protections have not been verified and enabled on the server.
errors.writesDisabled: Account changes are disabled on the server.
errors.receiptUnavailable: This browser could not retain an operation receipt. No request was sent.
errors.profileUnavailable: This account is no longer available. Close the editor and reload users.

userManagement.roleGate: Administrator and Editor assignment requires verified server guards. Profile name and language can still be edited when writes are enabled.
userManagement.deletionUnavailable: Account deletion is unavailable in this workspace.
userManagement.deploymentNotice: The deployed Edge Function does not report supported roles. Update the matching admin-users contract before enabling account changes.
userManagement.inviteConfiguration: Invitations are unavailable: the server invitation redirect must match an allowed application origin and /reset-password.
userManagement.reloadProfile: Discard edits and reload current profile

rbac.deniedCopy: Your current role does not allow access to this page or operation.
rbac.writeGate: Draft editing and uploads are disabled until database permission checks are verified.

cms.catalogRefresh: Published changes appear in the museum after using Reload catalog. Drafts and inactive placements stay out of the public catalog.
cms.taxonomyError: Categories and sections could not be loaded. Retry before saving.
cms.notFound: This exhibit was removed or is unavailable to your account.
cms.inspectBeforeRetry: Refresh the list and inspect the result before repeating this operation.
cms.discardReload: Discard unsaved metadata and file selections and load the latest exhibit?

validation.tooLong: This value exceeds the allowed length.
validation.slug: Use a slug without spaces, slashes, question marks or hash marks.
validation.integer: Enter a whole number in the supported range (year 0–9999; order −2147483648–2147483647).
validation.url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL without embedded credentials.
validation.taxonomyMissing: Choose an existing category and section before publishing.
validation.taxonomyInactive: Choose an active category and section. Existing inactive assignments can be retained in drafts.

drafts.available: Unsaved CMS draft found. Restore it or discard it.
drafts.stale: The server record has changed. Recovered edits keep their original version; review or reload before saving.
drafts.files: After a full reload, select upload files again. File contents are not stored.
drafts.replace: Discard current unsaved edits and open another record?
